sources.title: ONNX Model Zoo - GitHub
sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. sources.title: tuneperfect/beat-this-onnx · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: logmel.onnx: input audio[samples] float32, 22.05 kHz mono. Output spect[frames, 128], the model's log mel spectrogram, 50 frames per second. Computed with plain convolutions rather than the STFT op. beat_this.onnx: input spect[1, frames, 128], one chunk of at most 1500 frames. Outputs beat and downbeat logits [1, frames]. The batch size is fixed at 1.
